name: Cleric Draconic Channeler
body:
Dragons are the eldest of Vandara’s denizens and remain among the most powerful. As a result, they have acquired no shortage of worshippers wishing to strengthen themselves from their attachment to these beings.

Domains: A draconic channeler must select the Scalykind domain with the dragon subdomain as one of their domains.

Draconic Potency (Su)

Starting at 4th level, by expending a use of channel energy as part of using her dragonbreath domain ability, a draconic channeler may use her dragonbreath domain ability without expending one of its daily uses.

Dragon Caller (Su)

A draconic channeler adds the following creatures to the list of creatures they are capable of summoning with various summon monster spells. Any summoned dragon must be of a type that is normally the same alignment as the draconic channeler.

Summon Monster V

Wyrmling dragon of any type Summon monster VI: Very young dragon of any type Summon monster VII: Young dragon of any type Summon monster VIII: Young adult dragon of any type Summon monster IX: Adult dragon of any type.
